sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Compiler settings for the database package
sections.what: Sets how TypeScript compiles the database package. It inherits shared rules, writes output to a dist folder, and checks only source files.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps compiled output separate from source. Reason for disabling composite mode is not stated.
sections.watch_out: Changing the root folder setting can break the build because generated code must stay inside it.

summary: Compiler settings for the database package that compile only the source folder into an output folder.
purpose: Lets type checking and building of the database package use the shared workspace rules.
why: Likely reason: keeps compiled output separate from source while sharing workspace defaults. Reason for turning off composite mode is not stated.
how: First it inherits the workspace base settings. Then it sets the output folder and the source root. It turns off composite build mode and includes every TypeScript file under the source folder, excluding installed packages and the output.
inputs: The workspace base settings file and the source folder.
outputs: Type check results and compiled output in the output folder.
risks: Generated database code sits inside the source folder, so type checks fail until it has been generated.
debug: If type checking reports missing modules, run the database generate step. If output appears in the wrong place, check the output setting.
